messages:
maya: Customer (ACME) escalated — after upgrading to python SDK 1.14.0 they see intermittent 401s and duplicate billing for what should be a single request. They also report streaming responses appearing twice. Attached log snippet.

maya: log excerpt: "TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout_ms'" and stack pointing at client.generate -> http_request -> headers merge.

alex: Can you paste pip freeze and a minimal repro?

maya: pip freeze:
redwood-sdk==1.14.0
requests==2.31.0
python-dotenv==0.21.0

maya: Minimal repro:
```
from redwood import Client
import os
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
resp = c.generate("hello", timeout_ms=5000)
print(resp)
```
This raises TypeError on call and logs show two outbound POSTs in <200ms.

ryan: Quick triage: release notes for 1.14.0 removed the legacy `timeout_ms` param in favor of `timeout` (seconds) and flipped the default to enable auto-retry at the client level. If a customer also wraps calls with retries, you can end up submitting twice. Separately we changed auth header precedence to prefer `Authorization: Bearer` over `X-Api-Key`; some gateway shims accept the first attempt differently which leads to a 401 then a retry that succeeds — looks like both attempts may be billed.

release-bot: [changelog] v1.14.0 — removed `timeout_ms`; auto-retry enabled by default; auth header precedence changed. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/releases/tag/v1.14.0

alex: Recommended immediate mitigation for the customer: pin to 1.13.2 (temporary), or explicitly disable SDK retries and migrate `timeout_ms` -> `timeout` (seconds). Example workaround:
```
from redwood import Client
import os
# disable SDK-level automatic retries
c = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], retries=0)
resp = c.generate("hello", timeout=5)  # timeout in seconds
```
Or set env: `REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTO_RETRY=1` until we ship a fix. Also ask them to ensure they are not doing an outer retry wrapper.

maya: Customer pinned to 1.13.2 and set REDWOOD_DISABLE_AUTO_RETRY=1 — they report duplicate billing stopped. Waiting on billing team to reconcile the two invoice lines.

alex: Filing internal tracking INF-1428 to reintroduce a compatibility shim for `timeout_ms` and make auto-retry opt-in by default again (and add clearer auth header behavior docs). Will aim for 1.14.1 patch. Pinged @eng-runtime.

maya: Thanks — marking the ticket escalated and will update customer when the 1.14.1 is out. :thumbsup:
